name: Grupo Media Capital, SGPS, S.A.
note: Portuguese media group listed on Euronext Lisbon; its flagship generalist TV channel is TVI. Holders of 5% or more of capital and voting rights at 15 September 2025 (its own shareholder-disclosure page, https://mediacapital.pt/investidores/acao-media-capital/): Pluris Investments, S.A. 37.11% (the vehicle of businessman Mário Ferreira, chairman of the Media Capital board); Triun, SGPS, S.A. 23%; BIZ Partners, SGPS, S.A. 11.9725%; CIN - Corporação Industrial do Norte, S.A. 11.20%; Zenithodyssey, Lda 10%. Prisa (Spain) exited entirely in November 2020. No state in the chain. Replaces the stale 'medialuanda' record, which wrongly described Prisa as ultimate controller.
